name: new_bank_v1_song_250hz_exploratory
source: user-supplied Song HDF5 v3 8-channel sessions on 2026-09-18
preprocessing: existing causal continuous-session 40 Hz highpass plus 50/100 Hz notch, no test-fitted state
classifier: source-window StandardScaler plus balanced LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 random_state=20260924
score_unit: one probability vector per formal native trial by mean of its available window probabilities
selection_rule: No feature or arm changes after session scores. S04 was already used by earlier studies, so its result is exploratory confirmation only and cannot be called newly blind final evidence.
scope: One person's four same-day sessions; offline cue labels, no live latency or multi-person/day claim.
